dict.string: Snap a campus event flyer so RetroHabits can check it against your schedule.
Record quick voice notes about your workouts and day so your assistant can log and remember them.
RetroHabits talks to your assistant server on this Wi-Fi to summarize your agenda.
RetroHabits shows events from your iPhone calendars (Apple Calendar and any synced account, like your school email) in your daily agenda.
